'beard' Mn., dāḍaka- m. 'tooth' lex. Semant. development 'fang — tusk — beard' is possible (Rivet BSL 83, 143). But MIA. dāṭhā- < daṁṣṭrā- is phonet. difficult. IA. long vowel), spread of which at the cost of daṭṭha- was favoured by clash of the latter with daṭṭha- < daṣṭa- and dr̥ṣṭá-. Possibility of further Drav. (J. Bloch BSOS v 741) or Mu. (PMWS 63) influence cannot be excluded. — √daṁś]14597 *dāṁṣṭra-
